📢 Details of the meeting between the Foreign Minister of the Islamic Republic of Iran and the Foreign Minister of Germany

◀️ Seyyed Abbas Araghchi, the Foreign Minister of the Islamic Republic of Iran, who has traveled to New York to attend the annual session of the United Nations General Assembly, met and held talks on Wednesday morning on the sidelines of the session with Johann Wadephul, the Foreign Minister of Germany.

◀️ During this meeting, views were exchanged on bilateral relations between Iran and Germany as well as regional and international issues.

◀️ Our country's Foreign Minister, while outlining the positions of the Islamic Republic of Iran regarding international developments, stated that rebuilding trust in the functioning of the United Nations requires all governments to adhere to the principles and objectives of the Charter and international law, and criticized the conduct of European countries, including Germany, for their appeasement of America's law-breaking and bullying.

◀️ The Foreign Minister also, referring to the ongoing occupation and warmongering by the Zionist regime in the West Asia region, described Germany's military and political support, along with that of certain other European countries, as a major factor in the continuation of this regime's crimes against the countries of the region, and stressed the need to stop this kind of complicity in crimes, end impunity, and hold the occupying regime accountable.

◀️ The Foreign Minister further, while explaining Iran's responsible approach in resorting to diplomacy regarding Iran's peaceful nuclear issue, noted: No party can disregard Iran's goodwill in the negotiations and America's and the Zionist regime's military aggression against Iran in the middle of the talks, and portray Iran as the cause of insecurity in the Strait of Hormuz.

◀️ Our country's Foreign Minister emphasized that the Islamic Republic of Iran has conveyed logical conditions and requirements for advancing diplomacy to the American side, and stressed that restoring security to the region requires an end to America's interventionist and aggressive actions against Iran.

◀️ During this meeting, views were also exchanged on bilateral relations and diplomatic and consular consultations between the two countries.

_ Eslahat News
